description: This is a Sources Sought Notice (W912BU26X1BJA) to identify potentially qualified sources to support a possible $249M Firm-Fixed Price award of a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) to provide Power Construction and Services to the United States Central Command (CENTCOM) Area of Responsibility (AOR) and select countries outside CENTCOM (Ukraine, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Kosovo, Bosnia, Norway, Turkey, Slovakia, and Greenland). This is a Sources Sought Notice and is for informational/ market research purposes only. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS, QUOTATIONS, OR BIDS. NO SOLICITATION IS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE. Please access the below PIEE Solicitation Module Link for W912BU26X1BJA to view the attachment titled PCS_II_Sources_Sought_3APR2026 for more information and submission instructions.
